classes.description: A claimed regression fails on the base because the overlaid head test code does not run there, not at the assertion it claims.

occurrences.note: Four new shell cases and the unchanged walking control aborted on the base on a constant only the head fixture read, so the replay credited failures that never reached their assertions.
A claimed shell case failed on the base partly because the head fixture's page sequence no longer matched the old driver.

classes.description: A test replaces the policy it claims to guard, such as running an extracted function under its own shell options instead of the script's.

occurrences.note: The failed-install test extracted the reader step and ran it under its own errexit, so removing errexit from the build script still passed.
The repaired test copied the build script's set line without its position, so moving that line below the call still passed.

classes.description: A behaviour is claimed without executable proof: a specified state or required observation has no check that fails when it regresses.

occurrences.note: The hidden lead-in had no test of what the player sees: removing the hidden check from the boss's visibility left every test green.
A required browser witness of a ranged attack across the flood was replaced by a melee hit after the player walked into the safe square.
